description: FSA and timestamp must be present for every row.
The cleaned dataset must contain one row per FSA and timestamp.
Required field 'fsa' must not be missing.
Required field 'timestamp' must not be missing.
Required field 'total_consumption_kwh' must not be missing.
Required field 'reported_premise_count' must not be missing.
Electricity consumption must not be negative.
Reported premise count must not be negative.
Relative humidity must be between 0 and 100 percent.
'Precip. Amount (mm)' must not contain negative values.
'Wind Spd (km/h)' must not contain negative values.
'Visibility (km)' must not contain negative values.
Wind direction in tens of degrees must be between 0 and 36.
Calendar year must agree with timestamp.
Calendar month must agree with timestamp.
Calendar day must agree with timestamp.
Calendar hour must agree with timestamp.
Binary field 'is_weekend' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_workday' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_monday' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_friday' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_business_hour' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_peak_hour_window' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_month_start' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_month_end' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_year_start' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_year_end' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_public_holiday' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_day_before_holiday' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_day_after_holiday' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_long_weekend' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_daylight_saving_time' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_dst_transition_day' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_spring_forward_day' must contain only 0 or 1.
Binary field 'is_fall_back_day' must contain only 0 or 1.
Every FSA must preserve 24 source-aligned hours on DST transition dates.
